meta.title: Revora: Growth Is a System
meta.description: Revora connects customer acquisition, sales, operations, data and technology to find where your growth is being lost, and fix it.

hero.title: Growth is *a system*.
hero.subtitle: Revora connects acquisition, sales, operations, data and technology to find where your growth is being lost, and fix it.

contrast.title: Without a system, *growth* leaks away.
withoutItems: Leads lost for lack of follow-up
No reliable numbers to decide with

pillars.body: Each pillar covers a stage of your growth, served by modules of the platform.

items.title: Acquisition

items.title: Sales
items.body: Turn leads into sales, and follow them through.

items.title: Operations

items.title: Data

items.title: Technology
items.body: Connect your tools and adapt the platform to your business.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: We study how your business works, from the first contact to the cash collected.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.body: We find where growth is lost: leads not followed, sales stuck, stock poorly managed.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We set up the system: the platform, its configuration and your team’s processes.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: We measure results, correct and improve, month after month.

platform.title: One platform, *your whole business*.
platform.body: Revora brings your customers, sales, stock and numbers together in one app, in French and Arabic.

rows.title: A dashboard, *all your numbers*.
rows.body: Sales, payments, stock and due dates, at a glance.

items.title: Live indicators
items.body: Revenue, payments and receivables, updated continuously.

items.title: Useful alerts
items.body: Stock-outs and overdue items flagged before they cost you.

items.title: Exportable reports
items.body: Statements ready to share with your accountant.

rows.title: A pipeline *you can follow*.
rows.body: Every lead has a stage, an owner and a next action.

items.title: Visual pipeline
items.body: Drag each lead from one stage to the next.

items.title: Scheduled follow-ups
items.body: No lead forgotten, no sale left sleeping.

items.title: Shared history

orbit.title: 20 modules, *one system*.
orbit.body: Turn on what your business needs. Modules share the same customers, products and invoices.

builders.title: Built by *practitioners*.
builders.body: Revora was born from real market experience, not theory. Our team has worked in marketing, sales and back office, and partners with businesses that want to grow over the long term, across industries.

points.title: Marketing
points.body: Acquisition and campaigns, from the first contact to a qualified lead.

points.title: Sales
points.body: Pipeline, negotiation and customer follow-up, every day.

points.title: Back office
points.body: Invoicing, stock, accounting and processes that hold up over time.

services.title: Beyond the software, *we support you*.
services.body: An audit to find the growth being lost, then setup, training and follow-up.

items.title: Audit
items.body: We analyse how your business works and identify where growth is being lost.

items.title: Setup
items.body: Platform configuration, data import and set-up of your modules.

items.title: Training
items.body: Your team learns to use the system every day, in French or Arabic.

items.title: Ongoing support
items.body: Continuous support to improve results and evolve the system with your growth.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, *in dinars*.
pricing.body: One price per user per month. Prices are indicative and will be confirmed before launch.

items.question: What exactly does Revora do?
items.answer: Revora helps businesses build a growth system. It connects acquisition, sales, operations, data and technology, through a platform and hands-on support.

items.question: What is the difference between the platform and the services?
items.answer: The platform is the software, with its modules, that you use every day. The services are the support: audit, setup, training and follow-up. You can choose one without the other.

items.question: Which businesses do you work with?
items.answer: Algerian businesses of all sizes and industries, whether trade, services or manufacturing.

items.question: Is the platform available in Arabic and French?
items.answer: Yes. Revora is available in French, Arabic and English, with a right-to-left layout for Arabic.

items.question: Where is my data hosted?
items.answer: Your data can be hosted in Algeria, or on your own servers with the on-premise offer. You remain the owner of your data.

cta.title: Where are you losing growth? *Let’s do the audit.*
cta.body: A free diagnosis to identify what holds your growth back, and the first actions to take.
